name: Sanctifica
description: '''Sanctifica''' was a Swedish [[unblack metal]] band that formed in 1996 and disbanded in 2003. After releasing the EP ''In the Bleak Midwinter'' in 1997, they were considered a leading modern [[Christian black metal]] band in the early 2000s with the album ''[[Spirit of Purity]]''. Signed to Swedish [[Christian Rivel|Rivel Records]] and Finnish [[Deuteronomium (band)#Little Rose Productions|Little Rose Productions]], the band played [[progressive death metal]] on their second and last album, ''[[Negative B]]''. They toured Scandinavia to support that album, performing at well-known rock clubs in important cities. Hubertus Liljegren went on to join [[Crimson Moonlight]], while the rest formed rock group As a Reminder.
